title: The 3 Best Travel Backpacks for Weekend Trips
h1: The 3 Best Travel Backpacks for Weekend Trips
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for travel backpacks for weekend trips, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel backpacks for weekend trips using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cotopaxi Allpa 35L Travel Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 35L suitcase-style opening, Air-mesh back panel, Removable hip belt.
strengths: 35L is sized correctly for 2 to 4 days without wasted space
Suitcase-style opening makes packing for a short trip fast
Fits under most airline seats as a personal item
limitations: Not enough room for a week or longer without compressing packing
Hip belt is thin and mostly cosmetic at this size
Fewer external quick-grab pockets than a dedicated daypack

products.name: Osprey Farpoint 40
products.blurb: Key specs: 40L with removable 11L daypack, LightWire frame suspension, Stowable harness.
strengths: The detachable 11L daypack alone works as a minimalist weekend bag
One pack covers both weekend trips and longer travel without buying a second bag
Structured harness carries a weekend load comfortably even half-packed
limitations: 40L is more capacity than most weekend trips need
Bulkier as a personal item than the smaller Cotopaxi 35L
Two-piece system (pack plus daypack) is more than a simple weekend trip usually requires

products.name: Cotopaxi Allpa 42L Travel Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 42L suitcase-style opening, 15-inch laptop sleeve, 1000D TPU-coated polyester shell.
strengths: Extra volume over the 35L version covers a long weekend plus a laptop and work clothes
Same fast suitcase-style packing layout as the smaller Allpa
Durable shell handles being tossed in a car trunk or overhead bin repeatedly
limitations: Larger than necessary for a strict 2 to 3 day trip
Heavier empty weight than the 35L version
No meaningful advantage over the 35L if you're not also bringing work gear

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
